mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%) signals an accommodative monetary policy environment, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This signal is active whenever the rate is at or below 0.5%, which is the current state.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 235, it indicates accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy. This leads to higher discount rates and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 235, or the Rank IC for CPIAUCSL as a predictor of 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-rate environment (FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%) combined with high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 230), the market anticipates aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This interaction of monetary policy and inflation signals a negative equity return environment.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS <= 0.5 AND CPIAUCSL > 230, or the Rank IC for the interaction of FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL as predictors of 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP growth (GDPC1) exceeds 16000 billion and unemployment (UNRATE) falls below 6.0%, the economy is in a late-cycle expansion phase. This signals overheating and impending monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where GDPC1 > 16000 AND UNRATE < 6.0, or the Rank IC for the interaction of GDPC1 and UNRATE as predictors of 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 6.0%) signals economic weakness and the likelihood of Federal Reserve rate cuts, which reduces risk-free rates and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This signal is active whenever unemployment is above 6.0%, which is the current state.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE > 6.0%, or the Rank IC for UNRATE as a predictor of 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 101.5, it signals an imminent economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days. This is because a decline in industrial output indicates weakening economic activity, increasing recession risk and causing equity sell-offs.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO < 101.5, or the Rank IC for INDPRO as a predictor of 5-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1000 and residential fixed investment (RSAFS) falls below 430000, it signals a severe weakness in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of broader economic weakness. This leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where HOUST < 1000 AND RSAFS < 430000, or the Rank IC for the interaction of HOUST and RSAFS as predictors of 60-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 235), a rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 0.1) signals aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This mechanism is active only when both conditions are met.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 235 AND FEDFUNDS > 0.1, or the Rank IC for the interaction of CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS as predictors of 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
